skills.name: adversarial-verification
skills.description: Use when claims or evidence need adversarial validation by 3-5 independent agents. Requires unanimous convergence. Triggers: patents, papers, grants, investor relations, legal docs, numeric claims, novelty, prior-art, and fact-checking.

skills.name: agent-security-scan
skills.description: Use for report-only static scans of settings, hooks, skills, Model Context Protocol config, credential surfaces, remote fetches, shell side effects, and broad exposure risks.

skills.name: boundary-contract
skills.description: Use when task-router requires a boundary contract.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Use when design or expected behavior remains unresolved before implementation. Not for re-approving settled decisions.

skills.name: compact-handoff
skills.description: Use when long context, an agent transfer or session compaction could lose evidence, state and next actions; before transferring a task to another session or agent, or before requesting compaction.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Use when two or more independent tasks can be handled in parallel. Each task must be able to proceed without shared state or sequential dependency.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Use when an accepted implementation plan is ready for inline execution in the authorized checkout.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Use when implementation is ready for integration, when the user asks to merge or publish a pull request, or when the branch finishing path remains undecided.

skills.name: merge-companion
skills.description: Use before the selected work modifies, replaces or installs an installed skill, and when the user asks to review backed-up changes. Not for a bounded read-only lookup unrelated to those changes.

skills.name: necessity-gate
skills.description: Task-justification gate for new tasks, skills, files, audit cycles, or follow-ups. Compares problem evidence, regression risk, and recovery benefit; decides approve, reject, or modify. Blocks speculative work.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Use when receiving code review feedback before implementing suggestions, especially when feedback is ambiguous or technically questionable. Enforces technical rigor and verification instead of performative agreement or blind implementation.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Use after completing major functionality, before merging, or when a pull request has new commits, automated findings, or unresolved review threads.

skills.name: session-intent-analyzer
skills.description: Use when stored intent affects work selection or a semantic update is needed.

skills.name: skill-evolution
skills.description: Use when the user asks about skill upgrades, update recommendations, or an evolution backlog.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Use when executing an implementation plan composed of independent tasks in the current session.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use for a failure whose cause and sufficient correction depth need investigation, and for repair limits.

skills.name: task-router
skills.description: Use for work: a request that needs inspection, execution, modification or fresh verification, or one where it is unclear whether a tool is needed. Not for a direct answer or a light-path lookup.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing a feature or bug fix whose expected behavior is known and testable by an automated test. Not for changes without a meaningful behavioral test, such as configuration or instruction edits; discover an unknown target first.

skills.name: using-coding-convention
skills.description: Use when routing selects development work. A direct answer or a confirmation question ends before this development workflow.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Use only when the authorized development task requires an isolated checkout.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use before a new completion, fix, success, verified-status or material recommendation claim and before rereading an artifact to support a claim.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when requirements for a multi-step task are known and before touching code. Documents everything as bite-sized tasks for an engineer with zero codebase context. Use for implementation plans, task decomposition, and planning before TDD.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Use when writing a new skill or modifying/verifying an existing skill.
